claims.title: Use qualified task bounds for threshold decisions without identifying a hidden model

quoted_fields.interface: Receive the actual named task, nonempty admissible family, warranted bounds (an unbounded side may be infinite), governing qualification/event and costs, and an actual threshold in matching units. For the observation branch, receive matching attained endpoint witnesses that remain admissible in the justified exact or noisy fibre. No bound, observation, sensor, probability model or physical input is acquired by naming this interface.
quoted_fields.failure: No conversion between different tasks, units, support, posterior weights or validity events is inferred. A common consumer creates navigation among providers, not a transfer between them. A loose straddling interval is only unresolved by those bounds; actual ambiguity requires witnesses on both sides. Unchanged robust support bounds can coexist with improved Bayes risk. A small remaining-benefit bound is not a small absolute-error guarantee. No working device, measured effect, historical novelty or practical advantage is established.
